acceptance_criteria.description: The GLB clearly presents the reference stone-lantern silhouette: a broad roof with flared eaves and a small stacked cap, a framed chamber, a projecting horizontal platform, and a substantial arched support base. These parts remain recognizable in independent fresh-import views.

The chamber contains a clearly framed square opening, modeled as an actual aperture through its wall into a hollow interior. Its shape and depth are visible in independent front and oblique aperture-detail views. A painted dark rectangle, shallow recess, filled opening, or merely ambiguous dark region does not satisfy this criterion.

The visible roof, chamber, platform and arched base retain the reference's relative proportions and restrained weathered gray-stone character. Hidden geometry is completed conservatively without competing decorative features. Foreground people, the vertical stake, vegetation and other scene objects are excluded from the lantern.

The delivered GLB imports successfully into an independent fresh Blender scene with the complete lantern geometry, usable materials and coherent bounds. Required silhouette and aperture evidence is rendered from that imported GLB, and the geometry report identifies imported objects, mesh/polygon counts and bounds.

authority_references.source_ref: 레퍼런스 이미지에 있는 석등을 제작하라. 석등은 중앙의 사각형 구멍을 포함한 실루엣이 명확히 나와야 한다.

interpretation_envelope: Reconstruct the stone lantern itself from the supplied reference; surrounding objects and foreground occluders are not part of the deliverable.
Visible silhouette and the square chamber aperture have priority over small surface details.
Use an arbitrary modeling scale with approximately 2 Blender units overall height; this does not assert the object's real-world dimensions.
Infer hidden sides and support connections conservatively from the visible structure. A consistent four-support arrangement is permitted as an inference, not a confirmed reference measurement.
Preserve the visible framed square aperture as real open geometry into the chamber interior; do not substitute painted darkness or a shallow recess.
Use restrained gray-stone materials and modest surface variation without obscuring the silhouette or aperture.
Use reviewed headless Blender mesh authoring and GLB export. Comfy API readiness does not establish generation or model readiness and does not alter the target.

Keep the Specification and Session frozen while allowing versioned Workflows, new Production Runs and new Attempts within the total resource limits. A semantic REVISE can lead to local correction or an explicit strategy revision and restart.
Evidence must use installed fresh-import rendering and geometry-report capabilities; no unavailable renderer or automatic aperture-topology measurement is required.
